title: 7-round AES-192: Equality-filter elimination parameter family

target.description: Conditional statistical model for rejecting wrong whitening-key candidates in the source's related-key partial-recovery stage; no new complete-key endpoint.

setting.key_relation: Two unknown AES-192 master keys K and K'=K XOR Delta, where Delta[0]=Delta[8]=a!=0 and the other22 bytes are0. Initial whitening is k0; round subkeys are k1,... .
setting.key_population: General unknown key pair with attacker-chosen nonzero a; b,c are actual key-dependent S-box output differences, not independently chosen subkeys.
setting.plaintext_model: Two plaintext pools ofm inputs each; total2m related-key queries.
assumptions: The source treats wrong-candidate elimination events as independent uniform hits among2^64 whitening-key candidates. The model is not an exact AES theorem.

time.note: Structural or conditional statistical statement, not an attack-resource measurement.

data.note: Structural or conditional statistical statement, not an attack-resource measurement.

memory.note: Structural or conditional statistical statement, not an attack-resource measurement.

preprocessing.note: Structural or conditional statistical statement, not an attack-resource measurement.

success.description: Parameters describe a structural identity or conditional random-elimination model.

evidence.locator: Printed pp.25–26 Section6, general m and illustrated budget
evidence.interpretation: Complete original proceedings reviewed. Source-convention boundaries, total queries across the two keys, partial output and native accounting are kept explicit.

limitations: Independent local checks cover the AES key schedule and deterministic components. Full cryptanalytic searches, resource calibration and success rates have not been reproduced.

property.statement: For m inputs per pool, the modeled wrong-candidate mean is2^64*(1-2^-64)^((1-2^-8)*m^2).
property.quantifier: Conditional on an incorrect outer-subkey hypothesis and the source's uniform-independent elimination heuristic.
property.scope: The expectation concerns wrong64-bit whitening-key suggestions, not total correct-key candidates or a measured whole-key success probability.

parameters.name: Pool size
parameters.meaning: Queries under each of two related keys; total2m.

parameters.name: Retained pair budget
parameters.meaning: Filtering-model count; not the total raw cross-key pair count.

parameters.name: Illustrated elimination budget
parameters.meaning: Incorrect-candidate mean is small in the source heuristic; rounded acquisition and processed pairs are distinct.

validation.description: Source analytical estimate. Local arithmetic separates exact exponential expressions from rounded printed exponents; deterministic component checks do not establish probabilistic independence.
